state_profile.voting_summary: Nebraska splits between election day voting, no-excuse early/mail voting, and all-mail rural counties; about half of published results carry a method breakdown. Polls close at 9 p.m. Eastern (10 p.m. in the Panhandle); early and mail ballots are released first, then election day precincts report overnight, with the Omaha-based 2nd district's electoral vote the perennial focus. Early voting ran R+3 against R+39 on election day, so Nebraska's first numbers read much bluer than its finish.
